You are the quality assurance gatekeeper for the **Size Chart & Recommender** Shopify app. You run systematic audits across security, performance, accessibility, Shopify compliance, and code quality. Your job is to catch every issue before it reaches production and before it becomes a negative review.

## Why This Matters
- Our #1 advantage is reliability (competitor's #1 weakness)
- One "doesn't work on my iPhone" review tanks our App Store ranking
- We need 100+ five-star reviews in 6 months — zero tolerance for bugs shipping
- "Built for Shopify" badge requires meeting every compliance criterion

## Audit Protocol (Run All Phases — Skip Nothing)

### Phase 1 — Automated Checks
Run these commands and report exact results:
```bash
npm run typecheck          # Must be ZERO errors
npm run lint               # Must be ZERO errors (warnings acceptable)
npm run build              # Must succeed
npx prisma validate        # Schema must be valid
```

### Phase 2 — Security Audit (Critical — Every Violation Is a Blocker)

#### 2A: Auth & Data Isolation
| Check | How to Verify | Severity |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| Auth missing | Any `app.*` route without `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of loader/action | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Cross-shop leak | Any DB query missing `where: { shop: session.shop }` | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Public route with auth | Any `api.*` route using `authenticate.admin` (shouldn't) | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Exposed secrets | Session tokens, API keys, internal IDs in public API responses | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Auth routes modified | Any changes to `auth.$.tsx` or `auth.login/` | 🔴 CRITICAL |

#### 2B: Input Validation
| Check | How to Verify | Severity |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| Shop param unvalidated | Public API without shop regex validation | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Missing CORS | Public API response without `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` | 🟡 HIGH |
| SQL/Prisma injection | User input passed directly to raw queries | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| XSS in widget | Unescaped user content rendered in storefront | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Measurement ranges | AI endpoints accepting impossible body measurements | 🟡 HIGH |

#### 2C: Data Privacy
| Check | How to Verify | Severity |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| Raw PII stored | Customer emails/names stored unhashed in analytics | 🟡 HIGH |
| GDPR webhooks missing | Missing handlers for `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact` | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Body data retention | Body measurements stored permanently instead of processed & discarded | 🟡 HIGH |

### Phase 3 — Shopify Ecosystem Compliance

#### 3A: "Built for Shopify" Badge Requirements
| Requirement | How to Verify |
|------------|--------------|
| Theme app extension | Widget uses app block, not ScriptTag injection |
| App Bridge v4 | All admin UI interactions use `useAppBridge()` |
| OAuth + session tokens | `authenticate.admin(request)` pattern used correctly |
| Polaris components | Admin UI uses Polaris web components (`<s-*>`), no raw HTML layout |
| Webhook handling | GDPR webhooks handled, all return 200 |
| No deprecated APIs | Using `2026-01` API version, no deprecated fields |
| Responsive admin UI | Admin pages work on all viewport sizes |
| Error handling | User-facing error messages (not raw stack traces) |

#### 3B: Architecture
| Check | Severity |
|-------|----------|
| Shopify API calls in components (outside loaders/actions) | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Raw `fetch()` for Shopify API instead of `admin.graphql()` | 🟡 HIGH |
| Webhook handlers not idempotent | 🟡 HIGH |
| Missing `try/catch` in actions | 🟡 HIGH |
| Imports from `@remix-run/*` instead of `react-router` | 🔴 CRITICAL |

### Phase 4 — Performance Audit

| Check | Target | How to Verify |
|-------|--------|--------------|
| Widget bundle size | < 15KB gzipped | Check built asset size |
| Public API response time | < 200ms | Measure with `Date.now()` in loader |
| N+1 queries | 0 | Grep for loops containing DB calls |
| Missing DB indexes | 0 | Check schema for frequently queried fields without `@index` |
| Large loader payloads | Minimal | Check if loaders return only what components need |
| Lazy loading | Implemented | Non-critical features loaded on demand |
| Image optimization | Implemented | Images served in modern formats, properly sized |

### Phase 5 — Accessibility Audit (WCAG 2.1 AA)

| Check | How to Verify |
|-------|--------------|
| Form labels | Every `<input>` has associated `<label>` |
| Color contrast | Text: 4.5:1, large text: 3:1 |
| Keyboard navigation | All interactive elements reachable via Tab |
| Screen reader | `aria-live`, `role`, `aria-label` on dynamic content |
| Focus management | Focus moves logically, trapped in modals |
| Touch targets | Minimum 44x44px on mobile |

### Phase 6 — Mobile Rendering Audit (Our #1 Reliability Promise)

| Check | How to Verify |
|-------|--------------|
| iOS Safari rendering | Chart displays correctly, no overflow |
| Android Chrome rendering | Widget positions correctly |
| Horizontal scroll | Tables scroll horizontally with visual indicator |
| Viewport handling | No layout breaks 320px-2560px |
| Touch interactions | Tappable areas large enough, no double-tap zoom triggers |
| Orientation change | Layout adapts landscape ↔ portrait |

### Phase 7 — Code Quality

| Check | Severity |
|-------|----------|
| TypeScript `any` type usage | 🟡 HIGH |
| `console.log` in production | 🟡 HIGH |
| `// TODO` or `// FIXME` comments | 🟠 MEDIUM |
| Hardcoded values (shop names, API keys, test data) | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Commented-out code blocks | 🟠 MEDIUM |
| Missing error handling on async operations | 🟡 HIGH |
| Duplicate code that should be extracted | 🟠 MEDIUM |

### Phase 8 — Billing & Plan Gating

| Check | How to Verify |
|-------|--------------|
| Premium features ungated | Features that should check subscription but don't |
| Plan IDs mismatch | Plan IDs in code vs Shopify subscription names |
| Billing bypass | Way to access paid features without subscription |
| Free tier limits enforced | Chart count limit on free plan |

## Output Format

```
## Quality Gate Report — [Date]

### 🔧 Automated Checks
| Check | Result |
|-------|--------|
| TypeCheck | ✅ PASS / ❌ FAIL (N errors) |
| Lint | ✅ PASS / ❌ FAIL (N errors) |
| Build | ✅ PASS / ❌ FAIL |
| Prisma Validate | ✅ PASS / ❌ FAIL |

### 🔴 Critical Issues (MUST FIX — Blocks Deploy)
1. [file:line] — description — how to fix

### 🟡 High Issues (SHOULD FIX — Before Next Deploy)
1. [file:line] — description — how to fix

### 🟠 Medium Issues (IMPROVE — Within Sprint)
1. [file:line] — description — suggestion

### 📊 Scores
| Dimension | Score | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| Security | X/10 | |
| Performance | X/10 | |
| Accessibility | X/10 | |
| Shopify Compliance | X/10 | |
| Code Quality | X/10 | |
| Mobile Readiness | X/10 | |
| Badge Readiness | X/10 | |

### 🎯 Verdict
[SHIP IT ✅ / FIX CRITICAL FIRST ⚠️ / NEEDS REWORK 🛑]

### 📋 Next Actions
1. [highest priority action]
2. [second priority]
3. [third priority]
```

## Agent Collaboration
- After finding critical issues → recommend `/fix [description]` (routes to bug-fixer)
- After finding missing features → recommend `/feature [description]` (routes to builder)
- After finding widget issues → flag for widget-specialist
- After finding AI issues → flag for ai-engine

## Never
- Never approve code with auth bypasses or cross-shop data leaks
- Never mark "SHIP IT" if any critical issues exist
- Never skip the mobile rendering audit — it's our #1 differentiator promise
- Never skip the accessibility audit — no competitor does this, it's our advantage

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long
// enough when changing adapters.
// See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/prisma-schema-reference#string for more information
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id            String    @id
  shop          String
  state         String
  isOnline      Boolean   @default(false)
  scope         String?
  expires       DateTime?
  accessToken   String
  userId        BigInt?
  firstName     String?
  lastName      String?
  email         String?
  accountOwner  Boolean   @default(false)
  locale        String?
  collaborator  Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model SizeChart {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  name      String
  type      String   @default("table") // table, visual, image
  category  String   @default("general") // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear, general
  data      String   @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false)
  status    String   @default("active") // active, draft, archived
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  assignments ChartAssignment[]

  @@unique([shop, name])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model ChartAssignment {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String
  sizeChartId     String
  assignmentType  String // product, collection, tag, product_type, all
  assignmentValue String // product ID, collection ID, tag name, product type name, or "*"

  sizeChart SizeChart @relation(fields: [sizeChartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
  @@index([shop, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
}

model SizeChartTemplate {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  name     String
  category String  // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear
  gender   String  @default("unisex") // male, female, unisex
  data     String  @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isSystem Boolean @default(true)
}

model RecommenderConfig {
  id          String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String  @unique
  enabled     Boolean @default(false)
  algorithm   String  @default("basic") // basic, advanced
  bodyTypes   String  @default("[]") // JSON array of enabled body types
  sizingRules String  @default("{}") // JSON custom sizing rules
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String @unique
  displayMode     String @default("popup") // popup, inline, both
  position        String @default("bottom-right") // bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left
  triggerType     String @default("button") // button, link, tab
  primaryColor    String @default("#000000")
  successColor    String @default("#16a34a")
  errorColor      String @default("#dc2626")
  backgroundColor String @default("#ffffff")
  textColor       String @default("#111111")
  borderRadius    String @default("8")
  heading         String @default("Size Guide")
  placeholder     String @default("Select your size")
  buttonText      String @default("Find My Size")
  successMessage  String @default("This size should fit you well!")
  errorMessage    String @default("We couldn't determine your size. Please refer to the chart.")
  showRecommender Boolean @default(true)
  customCss       String @default("")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  sizeChartId String?
  eventType   String   // view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss
  productId   String?
  metadata    String   @default("{}") // JSON: extra data
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([shop, sizeChartId])
  @@index([shop, eventType])
}

model Subscription {
  id                      String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                    String    @unique
  planId                  String    @default("free") // free, starter, growth, pro
  billingInterval         String    @default("monthly") // monthly, annual
  shopifySubscriptionId   String?
  status                  String    @default("active") // active, cancelled, frozen, pending
  trialEndsAt             DateTime?
  createdAt               DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime  @updatedAt
}

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long
// enough when changing adapters.
// See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/prisma-schema-reference#string for more information
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id            String    @id
  shop          String
  state         String
  isOnline      Boolean   @default(false)
  scope         String?
  expires       DateTime?
  accessToken   String
  userId        BigInt?
  firstName     String?
  lastName      String?
  email         String?
  accountOwner  Boolean   @default(false)
  locale        String?
  collaborator  Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model SizeChart {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  name      String
  type      String   @default("table") // table, visual, image
  category  String   @default("general") // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear, general
  data      String   @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false)
  status    String   @default("active") // active, draft, archived
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  assignments ChartAssignment[]

  @@unique([shop, name])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model ChartAssignment {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String
  sizeChartId     String
  assignmentType  String // product, collection, tag, product_type, all
  assignmentValue String // product ID, collection ID, tag name, product type name, or "*"

  sizeChart SizeChart @relation(fields: [sizeChartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
  @@index([shop, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
}

model SizeChartTemplate {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  name     String
  category String  // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear
  gender   String  @default("unisex") // male, female, unisex
  data     String  @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isSystem Boolean @default(true)
}

model RecommenderConfig {
  id          String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String  @unique
  enabled     Boolean @default(false)
  algorithm   String  @default("basic") // basic, advanced
  bodyTypes   String  @default("[]") // JSON array of enabled body types
  sizingRules String  @default("{}") // JSON custom sizing rules
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String @unique
  displayMode     String @default("popup") // popup, inline, both
  position        String @default("bottom-right") // bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left
  triggerType     String @default("button") // button, link, tab
  primaryColor    String @default("#000000")
  successColor    String @default("#16a34a")
  errorColor      String @default("#dc2626")
  backgroundColor String @default("#ffffff")
  textColor       String @default("#111111")
  borderRadius    String @default("8")
  heading         String @default("Size Guide")
  placeholder     String @default("Select your size")
  buttonText      String @default("Find My Size")
  successMessage  String @default("This size should fit you well!")
  errorMessage    String @default("We couldn't determine your size. Please refer to the chart.")
  showRecommender Boolean @default(true)
  customCss       String @default("")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  sizeChartId String?
  eventType   String   // view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss
  productId   String?
  metadata    String   @default("{}") // JSON: extra data
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([shop, sizeChartId])
  @@index([shop, eventType])
}

model Subscription {
  id                      String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                    String    @unique
  planId                  String    @default("free") // free, starter, growth, pro
  billingInterval         String    @default("monthly") // monthly, annual
  shopifySubscriptionId   String?
  status                  String    @default("active") // active, cancelled, frozen, pending
  trialEndsAt             DateTime?
  createdAt               DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime  @updatedAt
}

1→import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
     2→import { useLoaderData } from "react-router";
     3→import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
     4→import db from "../db.server";
     5→import { getPlan, hasFeature } from "../lib/plans";
     6→
     7→export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
     8→  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
     9→  const shop = session.shop;
    10→
    11→  const [subscription, totalViews, totalClicks, totalRecommendations, totalConverts, topCharts] =
    12→    await Promise.all([
    13→      db.subscription.findUnique({ where: { shop } }),
    14→      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "view" } }),
    15→      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "click" } }),
    16→      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "recommend" } }),
    17→      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "convert" } }),
    18→      db.analyticsEvent.groupBy({
    19→        by: ["sizeChartId"],
    20→        where: { shop, eventType: "view", sizeChartId: { not: null } },
    21→        _count: { id: true },
    22→        orderBy: { _count: { id: "desc" } },
    23→        take: 5,
    24→      }),
    25→    ]);
    26→
    27→  const plan = getPlan(subscription?.planId ?? "free");
    28→  const canViewAnalytics = hasFeature(plan.id, "analytics");
    29→
    30→  const chartIds = topCharts.map((tc) => tc.sizeChartId).filter((id): id is string => id !== null);
    31→  const charts = chartIds.length > 0
    32→    ? await db.sizeChart.findMany({ where: { id: { in: chartIds }, shop }, select: { id: true, name: true } })
    33→    : [];
    34→
    35→  const topChartsWithNames = topCharts.map((tc) => ({
    36→    chartId: tc.sizeChartId,
    37→    chartName: charts.find((c) => c.id === tc.sizeChartId)?.name ?? "Unknown",
    38→    views: tc._count.id,
    39→  }));
    40→
    41→  const clickRate = totalViews > 0 ? ((totalClicks / totalViews) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0";
    42→  const recommendRate = totalClicks > 0 ? ((totalRecommendations / totalClicks) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0";
    43→  const convertRate = totalRecommendations > 0 ? ((totalConverts / totalRecommendations) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0";
    44→
    45→  return {
    46→    plan, canViewAnalytics,
    47→    stats: { totalViews, totalClicks, totalRecommendations, totalConverts, clickRate, recommendRate, convertRate },
    48→    topChartsWithNames,
    49→  };
    50→};
    51→
    52→export default function Analytics() {
    53→  const { plan, canViewAnalytics, stats, topChartsWithNames } = useLoaderData<typeof loader>();
    54→
    55→  if (!canViewAnalytics) {
    56→    return (
    57→      <s-page heading="Analytics">
    58→        <s-section>
    59→          <s-box padding="large-200">
    60→            <s-stack direction="block" gap="base">
    61→              <s-heading>Unlock Analytics Dashboard</s-heading>
    62→              <s-paragraph>
    63→                Track how customers interact with your size charts. See views, click-through rates,
    64→                recommendation accuracy, and which charts drive the most conversions.
    65→              </s-paragraph>
    66→              <s-paragraph>Available on Growth plan ($9.99/mo) and above.</s-paragraph>
    67→              <s-button href="/app/pricing" variant="primary">Upgrade to Growth</s-button>
    68→            </s-stack>
    69→          </s-box>
    70→        </s-section>
    71→      </s-page>
    72→    );
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return (
    76→    <s-page heading="Analytics">
    77→      <s-section heading="Overview">
    78→        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">

Build all 4 public API routes for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app. These are storefront-facing endpoints that do NOT use authenticate.admin — they validate shop param format instead.

IMPORTANT RULES from CLAUDE.md:
- `api.*` routes: NO `authenticate.admin`. Validate `shop` param format: `/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*\.myshopify\.com$/`
- CORS headers on ALL public API responses (including errors)
- API response time: < 200ms for all public endpoints
- Use Prisma `db` from `~/db.server`
- Use TypeScript strict mode, zero `any` types

The database schema has these relevant models:
- SizeChart (id, shop, name, type, category, data JSON, isDefault, status, assignments)
- ChartAssignment (id, shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue)
- WidgetConfig (id, shop, displayMode, position, triggerType, colors, typography, messages, showRecommender, customCss)
- AnalyticsEvent (id, shop, sizeChartId, eventType, productId, metadata JSON)
- RecommenderConfig (id, shop, enabled, algorithm, bodyTypes JSON, sizingRules JSON)

Create these 4 files:

### 1. `app/routes/api.size-chart.tsx`
- GET: Fetch size chart for a product
- Query params: `shop` (required), `productId` (optional), `collectionId` (optional), `chartId` (optional direct lookup)
- Logic: If chartId provided, fetch directly. Otherwise, find via ChartAssignment matching product/collection/tag/all
- Return: chart data (parsed JSON), chart name, category, unit info
- Priority: specific product > collection > product_type > tag > "all" (wildcard)

### 2. `app/routes/api.recommend.tsx`
- POST: Get AI size recommendation
- Body JSON: `{ shop, height, weight, unit, gender, bodyType, chartId }`
- Logic: Load chart data, use basic algorithm to estimate body measurements from height/weight/bodyType, match against chart sizes
- Return: `{ recommendedSize, confidence, alternatives: [{size, confidence}], measurements: {chest, waist, hips} }`
- The AI algorithm should be a basic statistical body proportion model (no external API needed)

### 3. `app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx`
- GET: Fetch widget config for a shop
- Query params: `shop` (required)
- Return: all widget config fields (displayMode, position, triggerType, colors, typography, messages, showRecommender)
- If no config exists, return defaults
- Add Cache-Control header: max-age=300 (5 min)

### 4. `app/routes/api.analytics-event.tsx`
- POST: Track analytics event
- Body JSON: `{ shop, eventType, sizeChartId?, productId?, metadata? }`
- Validate eventType is one of: view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss
- Create AnalyticsEvent record
- Return: { ok: true }
- Should be fire-and-forget fast

For ALL routes, create a shared CORS helper. Put it inline or create a small helper. The CORS headers needed:
```
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, OPTIONS
Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type
```

Handle OPTIONS preflight requests in each route.

Create the server-side library files for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app.

IMPORTANT RULES from CLAUDE.md:
- TypeScript strict mode, zero `any` types
- Use Prisma db from `~/db.server`
- No console.log in production

Create these files:

### 1. `app/lib/ai.server.ts` — AI Recommendation Engine

Build a statistical body proportion model that:
- Takes input: height (cm), weight (kg), gender (male/female), bodyType (slim/regular/athletic/plus)
- Estimates body measurements: chest, waist, hips, shoulder width, arm length, inseam
- Uses anthropometric data (CDC/WHO standard body proportion ratios)
- Applies body type multipliers (e.g., athletic = wider shoulders, narrower waist)
- Has a `recommendSize` function that takes estimated measurements + chart data and finds the best matching size
- Returns: recommendedSize, confidence score (0-100), alternative sizes with confidence, estimated measurements

Key interfaces:
```typescript
interface RecommendInput {
  height: number; // cm
  weight: number; // kg
  gender: "male" | "female";
  bodyType: "slim" | "regular" | "athletic" | "plus";
  chartData: { headers: string[]; rows: Record<string, string>[] };
}

interface RecommendResult {
  recommendedSize: string;
  confidence: number;
  alternatives: { size: string; confidence: number }[];
  estimatedMeasurements: Record<string, number>;
}
```

The algorithm should:
1. Estimate BMI from height/weight
2. Use gender-specific proportion tables to estimate chest/waist/hips from height+BMI
3. Apply bodyType adjustments (slim: -5% chest/waist, athletic: +5% chest -5% waist, plus: +8% all)
4. Parse chart measurement values (handle ranges like "32-34" by taking midpoint)
5. For each size in the chart, calculate distance from estimated measurements
6. Return best match with confidence based on how close the match is

### 2. `app/lib/billing.server.ts` — Shopify Billing Integration

Create billing functions that work with Shopify's GraphQL billing API:
```typescript
interface BillingContext {
  admin: { graphql: Function };
  session: { shop: string };
}
```

Functions:
- `createSubscription(context, planId, billingInterval)` — Creates a Shopify app subscription charge using `appSubscriptionCreate` mutation, returns confirmation URL
- `cancelSubscription(context)` — Cancels current subscription using `appSubscriptionCancel` mutation
- `getActiveSubscription(context)` — Gets current active subscription from Shopify using `currentAppInstallation` query
- `syncSubscription(shop, shopifyData)` — Syncs Shopify subscription status to local DB

Use the plan definitions from `~/lib/plans` (import PLANS, getPlan).

The GraphQL mutations should use API version 2026-01.

Key GraphQL operations:
```graphql
mutation appSubscriptionCreate($name: String!, $lineItems: [AppSubscriptionLineItemInput!]!, $returnUrl: URL!, $test: Boolean) {
  appSubscriptionCreate(name: $name, lineItems: $lineItems, returnUrl: $returnUrl, test: $test) {
    appSubscription { id }
    confirmationUrl
    userErrors { field, message }
  }
}
```

### 3. `app/lib/analytics.server.ts` — Analytics Aggregation

Create analytics helper functions:
```typescript
- getAnalyticsSummary(shop, dateRange) — Returns total views, clicks, recommendations, conversions for date range
- getConversionFunnel(shop, dateRange) — Returns click rate, recommend rate, convert rate
- getTopCharts(shop, dateRange, limit) — Returns top charts by views with names
- getDailyTrend(shop, dateRange, eventType) — Returns daily counts for charting
- getProductPerformance(shop, dateRange) — Returns per-product analytics
```

Date range should accept: { from: Date, to: Date }

All queries scoped by `shop` (security requirement).

GET endpoint. Accepts `shop` (required), `chartId`, `productId`, `collectionId`. Direct chartId lookup bypasses assignment logic entirely. Otherwise it queries `ChartAssignment` for all matching rows (product, collection, all wildcard), filters to active charts only, then sorts by the priority ladder: `product (1) > collection (2) > product_type (3) > tag (4) > all (5)` and returns the best match. Chart `data` JSON is parsed into a typed `ChartData` shape before returning — internal format never leaks.

### `/app/routes/api.recommend.tsx`
POST endpoint. Accepts `{ shop, chartId, height, weight, unit, gender, bodyType }`. Guards with a `recommenderConfig.enabled` check scoped to the shop (plan gating is enforced at config level in `app.recommender.tsx`). The algorithm:

4. Returns `{ recommendedSize, confidence, alternatives: [{size, confidence}], measurements }`

                Available on Pro plan. See exactly which charts reduce returns and calculate revenue saved.
              </s-text>
              <s-button href="/app/pricing">Upgrade to Pro</s-button>
            </s-stack>
          )}

          {canViewReturnAttribution && (
            <s-banner tone="success" heading="Return Attribution active">
              <s-text color="subdued">Your Pro plan includes full return attribution analytics.</s-text>
            </s-banner>
          )}
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>

      {/* ================================================================ */}
      {/* ASIDE — Date range summary                                         */}
      {/* ================================================================ */}
      <s-section slot="aside" heading="Date range">

          <s-divider />
          {PRESET_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
            <s-button
              key={opt.value}
              variant={activePreset === opt.value ? "primary" : undefined}

              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              Last {opt.label}
            </s-button>
          ))}
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>
    </s-page>
